question: Which of the following constitutes an advantage of the gamma interferon (IGRA) release assays against the tuberculin skin test in the diagnosis of latent tuberculosis infection?

options.opa: Avoid false positives from previous BCG vaccination.
options.opb: It has a greater capacity to predict reactivation tuberculosis.
options.opc: It has a greater ability to predict the efficacy of prophylaxis with isoniazid.
options.opd: Avoid false negatives due to anergy in highly immunosuppressed patients.
